output.headline: Corner-lot 3-bed in Austin with a quartz island kitchen and covered patio
output.mls_description:
Welcome to 4812 Ridgeview Dr, a 3-bedroom, 2-bath home on a corner lot in Austin. Built in 2016, it offers 1,820 square feet of living space centered on an open kitchen with a quartz island, a natural gathering spot for everyday meals and hosting alike.

Step outside to the covered back patio for shaded mornings and evenings outdoors. New carpet was installed in 2025, so the home is ready for its next owner to move right in. A two-car garage adds room for vehicles, tools and storage. The three bedrooms give you flexible space for an office, guests or a hobby room, and the two baths keep busy mornings moving.

Residents can enjoy the community pool, and downtown Austin is about 10 minutes away by car, which makes commuting, dining and weekend plans easy.

At a glance: 3 bedrooms, 2 baths, 1,820 sq ft, built in 2016, corner lot, two-car garage, community pool.

Offered at $449,000. Contact Jordan Rivera at Sample Realty Group, (512) 555-0142, to schedule a private showing.
